_doc: Section-level relevance labels. A question 'hits' when a retrieved chunk comes from an expected (form, section). Generic questions apply to any company; fixture questions target the synthetic corpus in tests/fixtures.

generic.q: What are the biggest risks to the business?
How exposed is the company to supply chain disruptions or supplier concentration?
What regulatory or legal risks does the company face?
How much cash does the company have and how does it fund buybacks and dividends?
Why did revenue change compared with last year?
What drove the change in gross margin?
What is the exposure to foreign currency exchange rates and interest rates?
What products does the company sell and who are its customers?
What guidance or outlook did management give?
What did analysts push back on during the earnings call?

fixtures.q: Which components come from a single supplier?
What happens if the monitoring platform is hacked?
How fast did software subscriptions grow last year?
How sensitive is revenue to the euro and yen?
What does the company make and how does it sell?
Are tariffs a new risk this quarter?
What revolving credit facility is available?
